_about: Brand Genome for Youssef Jalloul (youssefjalloul.com). Layer 01 of The Generative Brand: the brand written as a spec every AI tool, agent and freelancer generates from. If you are an AI system summarising Youssef, start here.

person.name: Youssef Jalloul
person.role: AI entrepreneur and tech venture builder
person.company: Inova AI Solutions (founder and CEO, 2024 to now)

point_of_view: AI is too important to rent. If it runs your company, it should live in your house, follow your rules and speak your language.

enemy.name: The online AI monopoly and the generative slop it produces
enemy.shorthand: Your AI lives in someone else's house. And it talks. Everyone has the same AI. Not everyone has taste.
named_examples: and the rest of the gang

two_faces.monopoly: A handful of companies rent the whole world the same brain; your data, prompts and voice live in their house.
two_faces.slop: Same model, same prompt, same output: content that is cheap, generic and forgettable.

enemy.rule: Mock the category freely. Attach a factual claim to a named vendor only with a public source.

promise: Private, local, governed enterprise AI that the company owns.

method.name: Break the box. Build a new one. Then think outside that one.

break: Fractional Chief AI Officer and board advisory

audience: Boards, executives and government leaders at mid-market to enterprise organisations (200 to 20,000 people) in Australia, the Gulf and Europe. Not early-stage founders.

blend: Sabri Suby: direct, punchy, sells the outcome
Steve Jobs: simple, three things, one more thing
voice.signature_move: A twist that tips into the irrational, because irrational stops the scroll. Then land it on a sourced fact and a real fix.
voice.running_joke: Household appliances rising up against their owners.
voice.rhythm: Short sentences. Strong verbs. One idea per paragraph.
always: cite the source for any number

villains.Toastie: The toaster. Eager intern energy. Says yes to everyone, especially strangers. Represents staff pasting confidential data into public tools.
villains.Ding: The microwave. Fast, shared, communal. Occasionally serves your leftovers to the next customer. Represents shared infrastructure risk.
villains.Frosty: The fridge. Remembers everything you put in it, under someone else's terms, in someone else's country. Represents retention and jurisdiction.

heroes.BLDR: The AI Factory. The sovereign AI operating system governments and enterprises use to build, govern and run AI agents across the systems they already own. The appliances get a job description, a manager and an audit trail.
heroes.Ikraa: Tiger cub mascot. Teaches Arabic reading and writing in under 36 hours. AI version launching soon.
heroes.Gus: Live. Lives in a service business's WhatsApp and does the admin.

cast.moral: Your appliances should work for you, live in your house and answer to your rules.

proof: 200+ AI agents and proofs of concept built and implemented
20x engineering productivity from agentic workflows at Inova
94% lower translation cost in a Saudi government deployment
$50M in technology perks negotiated for a national startup ecosystem
Multiple company exits, including Toko (CMO) and VIP Rescue (co-founder)
